page_title: CAD 3-1 VIL | Cadiz CF v Villarreal 01/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Today's referee Juan Pulido rightly decides to book Santi Comesana (Villarreal) for his harsh tackle.
90+2' Here is a change. Roger Marti is going off and Sergio gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz).
90+2' Substitution. Jose Mari (Cadiz) on for Ruben Alcaraz.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The number of offsides is – 2:2.
87' Roger Marti (Cadiz) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
86' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' Quique Setien decides to make a substitution. Ramon Terrats will be replaced by Kiko (Villarreal).
83' Substitution. Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) has come on for Gerard Moreno.
82' Fali (Cadiz) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Juan Pulido pulls out a yellow card.
80' A yellow card for a tackle by Luis Hernandez (Cadiz). Juan Pulido doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision. A free kick to Villarreal.
79' Cadiz CF take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
78' Substitution. Darwin Machis did his best and is replaced by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz).
77' Sergio has decided to make a change. Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) replaces Chris Ramos.
77' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
76' Villarreal have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
72' 14:13 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
70' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
70' Villarreal earn a corner.
68' Quique Setien has decided to substitute Alex Baena and he is replaced by Santi Comesana (Villarreal).
68' That will be all from Yeremy Pino who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal).
66' Cadiz CF failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
64' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
64' The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
61' Alex Baena (Villarreal) sees a yellow card from Juan Pulido after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' Alex Baena (Villarreal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Substitution. Ivan Alejo makes way for Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
55' A corner kick by Cadiz CF is thwarted by the well prepared Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal).
55' Luis Hernandez (Cadiz) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Cadiz CF force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
55' Total attempts – 14:4.
53' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
52' A first-time shot by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
50' 3 - 1 Darwin Machis (Cadiz) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes off the post into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:1.
48' Alex Baena (Villarreal) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
46' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Quique Setien, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
46' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.
45+3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Villarreal.
45+1' 9 additional min. will be played.

42' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
40' One of the players from Villarreal times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
39' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
37' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
35' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Raul Albiol (Villarreal) for a tough tackle.
34' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
32' Cadiz CF have a goal ruled out for offside!
30' 2 - 1 Goal! Darwin Machis (Cadiz) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Filip Jorgensen into the bottom left corner.
30' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) is going to take the penalty!
29' Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Pulido signals. The referee makes the call - penalty to Cadiz CF!
27' Substitution. Alexander Sorloth leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal).
27' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:3.
22' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is given a yellow card.
22' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) can have an early bath after being sent off by the referee for a tackle that simply has no place in football!
19' Juan Pulido has issued a yellow card to Chris Ramos (Cadiz).
18' 1 - 1 Chris Ramos (Cadiz) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Ruben Alcaraz shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.
18' Cadiz CF work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
17' The shots on goal statistics – 0:1.
12' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

12' Roger Marti (Cadiz) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. Cadiz CF will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
7' Some patient build-up play from Villarreal as they look to unlock the defence.

5' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
4' Roger Marti (Cadiz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cadiz CF.
3' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
3' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
2' The Villarreal players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will officiate today.
